pattern: Native fieldset and legend (HTML grouping): the legend names the group; help and the group error are referenced by aria-describedby.

aria.value: help and error ids while shown, followed by the page's own ids
true; '(required)' is spoken with the legend instead

keyboard.action: Moves through the group's controls in document order (the fieldset itself is not focusable).

focus: Never takes focus itself. focus() moves focus to the first enabled control, for Error Summary links.
notes: The group role cannot carry aria-required, so required state is spoken as part of the legend.
Native disabled removes every native control inside from the tab order.
knownCaveats: Screen readers differ in how often they repeat the legend when moving between controls; keep legends short.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
